subject: V1.2 changes - driving in reverse
author: senocular
body: A lot of what seems to be nice, but not too significant changes (though I guess there really shouldn't be - this is what a patch does).  One of them that caught my eye originally was the Marked Man exploit driving in reverse.  I tried that yesterday and it ended up causing the event to cancel.  I don't know, maybe I was doing it wrong.  Doesn't matter I guess; I wouldn't have the patience to go so slow to reach the destination anyway ;)
